     ENROLLMENT PROCEDURES 

This section guides parents on how to register/enroll their child thru online and onsite. 

 ONLINE REGISTRATION/ENROLLMENT PROCEDURES FOR NEW NORMAL EITHER OLD OR NEW STUDENTS:

Step 1. (For new student)  Email the softcopy of admission requirements at registrarsncs2004@gmail.com.  Wait for a reply and instruction to proceed in Step 2.

 *For incoming New Grade 7 students who want to avail an ESC grant, kindly send an email to registrarsncs2004@gmail.com for you to fill up the reservation form.  Wait for the instruction to proceed to Step 2.

	(For old students proceed to Step #2)

Step 2.   Register online using the link below. Fill out the Enrollment Form accurately in CAPITAL LETTERS.

         https://www.sncstaguig.com/registration/enrollment-form

Step 3.  Click submit.

Step 4. Online Payment Facility

NOTE:  

Kindly send an email to sncsfinance@gmail.com once payment done using online bank transfer facility for fast verification specifying the following details: name of the student, grade level, amount, etc.
